theme.description: Authority, clarity, and function-first. High-contrast dark charcoal text on light backgrounds with white cards and soft shadows. Accents of construction orange and yellow.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-extrabold text-[#171717]
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-[#171717]

surfaces_and_shadows.card: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-200 transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md
surfaces_and_shadows.input: bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-md focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#F97316] focus:border-[#F97316]

button.primary: bg-[#171717] text-white hover:bg-[#262626] font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-2 shadow-sm
button.accent: bg-[#F97316] text-white hover:bg-[#EA580C] font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-2 shadow-sm
button.outline: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#171717] text-[#171717] hover:bg-gray-50 font-semibold rounded-lg px-6 py-2

card.base: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6 overflow-hidden relative

charts.style: Clean lines, minimal grid, no default legends, custom tooltip with white bg and shadow-md

hero_background.description: Abstract 3D composition of construction elements and digital graphs with charcoal and orange tones.

marketing_workers.description: Modern construction workers for About or Features section.

dashboard_site_thumb.description: Glass and steel building for site thumbnail in dashboard.

landing_page.layout: Marketing grid (Tetris grid) with glassmorphism sticky header.
landing_page.hero_section: Dark charcoal text over light background. Accent orange CTA. The hero background image should be subtle, maybe as an accent shape or behind a glassmorphic card.
landing_page.features: Bento box layout with white cards, soft shadows, and high-contrast typography.
landing_page.pricing: 3 tiers (Free, Premium, Enterprise). Highlight Premium with border-[#F97316] and small shadow-lg.

dashboard.layout: Sidebar layout. Sidebar is Dark Charcoal (#171717) with white text. Main content area is Soft Gray (#F3F4F6).
dashboard.header: Top navbar with breadcrumbs, global search, and user profile. White background, border-b.
dashboard.cards: White cards (#FFFFFF), soft shadows, minimal padding (p-5), clear h4 headings.
dashboard.tables: Modern clean tables, no vertical borders, subtle gray horizontal borders, sticky headers.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Ensure all dashboard cards have a white background with a subtle shadow (shadow-sm).
Implement the sidebar with a Dark Charcoal (#171717) background to contrast with the light dashboard body.
Use Recharts for the Analytics sections, utilizing the accent colors (#F97316, #EAB308) for data visualization.
All forms should use Shadcn inputs with a focus state highlighting the accent orange (#F97316).
Adhere strictly to the color palette provided; do NOT use default tailwind blue or indigo.
